units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 25:4">Targ. Y. I Num. XXV, 4</cite>; Y. II <he>ויהוין צָלְבִין</he> (not <he>צְלָבִין</he>).

<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Esther 7:9">Targ. Esth. VII, 9</cite>; a. fr.—Part. pass. <he>צָלִיב</he>; Pl. <he>צְלִיבִין</he>. Targ. II Esth. IX, 24; a. e.—Y. Ḥag. II, 78ᵃ top <he>וצַלְבוּנוּן</he> and they impaled them (the sorceresses); a. e.
<cite ref="Onkelos Deuteronomy 21:23">Targ. O. Deut. XXI, 23</cite>. Targ. II Esth. IX, 14; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 3:14">Esth. R. to I, 12</cite> <he>מִצְטַלַּב</he>, v. <cite ref="E00650"><he>הָן</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 65">Gen. R. s. 65</cite> end <he>אזל קומי שריתא למִצְטַלְּבָה</he> (not <he>למצטבלה</he>) walked before the beam (on which he was) to be hanged; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 115:12">Yalk. ib. 115</cite> <he>למִצְטַלַּב</he>.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 28">Lev. R. s. 28</cite> <he>בעי למצטבלא</he> (corr. acc.) is going to be hanged; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 1058:3">Yalk. Esth. 1058</cite> <he>למִצַּלְּבָא</he>.
